نشتو (form VIII)
# نَشْتَوِ (naštawi) /naʃ.ta.wi/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِشْتَوَى (ištawā)
# نُشْتَوَ (nuštawa) /nuʃ.ta.wa/: first-person plural non-past passive jussive of اِشْتَوَى (ištawā)
